message: Yarn (Berry) 3.6.4 in yarnPath (.yarnrc.yml) does not support npmMinimalAgeGate (added in 4.10.2)
fix: Run yarn set version 4.10.2 (or a later release), which saves it in .yarn/releases, points yarnPath in .yarnrc.yml to it and sets packageManager in package.json, then run depcurfew apply again and commit the changes
